skip_reason: Services unavailable — backend and frontend not running during audit

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (RCE)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts a Handlebars template payload exploiting AST type confusion. If handlebars templates are rendered server-side with any user-controlled input, arbitrary JavaScript executes on the server.
escalations.impact: Remote code execution in template processing; full server compromise possible.
escalations.fix: Update handlebars to >= 4.7.10 or replace with a logic-less template engine.

escalations.title: proxy-addr IPv4-Mapped IPv6 Spoofing — Auth Bypass (CVSS 9.1)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends HTTP requests with ::ffff:127.0.0.1 in X-Forwarded-For header. Express trust proxy chain incorrectly classifies attacker IP as trusted localhost, bypassing IP whitelisting.
escalations.impact: Authentication/authorization bypass; trusted IP validation fails; Express middleware security controls defeated.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read + RCE (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.exploit_scenario: When Vitest UI server runs in development, attacker on the same network accesses arbitrary files via path traversal. Prototype pollution in tinypool worker pool options enables arbitrary code execution. Affects build/CI environments.
escalations.impact: Development environment compromise; source code and secrets disclosure; build-time RCE.
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to >= 5.1.1 (major version bump required).
escalations.note: Dev-only dependency; production runtime is not directly affected but build/CI pipeline is.

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via Crafted .proto Files (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker submits crafted gRPC messages or .proto schema files to the orchestrator. Prototype pollution in protobuf message constructors chains into code generation gadgets, achieving arbitrary code execution.
escalations.impact: Remote code execution in orchestrator process; orchestrator compromise gives access to all pipeline state.
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs to >= 7.6.5 or upgrade to >= 8.0.0.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer has single-plan scope — 7/8 plans silently pass the verification gate
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Developer adds new code with no traceability comment referencing a stale plan's requirements. The enforcer gate passes (green) because it only checks the most-recently-modified plan. The architecture rule 'Every FR needs a test' goes unenforced for 7 of 8 plans.
p1_findings.impact: False confidence in traceability; specification drift grows unchecked; audit gate gives green when 7/8 plans fail.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create tools/traceability-enforcer-all.sh that loops all Plans/*/requirements.md and fails on any miss. Update CLAUDE.md gate to call this wrapper.

p1_findings.title: Route handlers directly call in-memory store — service layer bypassed
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Developer adds validation logic to workItemService.ts assuming all mutations flow through it. Because routes bypass the service layer, the validation is never called. A malformed state transition or soft-delete bypass goes undetected.
p1_findings.impact: Architecture rule violation enables state machine abuse; service-layer invariants (soft-delete filtering, state transition validation) can be bypassed directly via routes.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts covering all CRUD operations. Refactor the three route files to use this service. Add a linting rule or test to prevent future direct store imports from routes.
p1_findings.cross_ref: Config threat: 'work item state machine integrity' and 'work item deletion via soft-delete'

p2_findings.title: 10 FR-TMP-* requirements in tiered-merge-pipeline spec — zero implementation, no plan file
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/ plan file or add 'Phase 2 — not yet planned' header so enforcer can skip.

p2_findings.title: 7 plans describe a replaced system (FR-001–FR-089) — stale spec debt
p2_findings.recommendation: Archive to Plans/_archived/ or explicitly mark superseded.

p2_findings.title: Placeholder FR-XXX / FR-XXXX / FR-0XX IDs in requirements files — enforcer noise
p2_findings.recommendation: Replace all placeholder IDs with real ones before plans become active.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage inflate coverage metrics
p2_findings.recommendation: Remove root-level duplicates; keep tests/pages/ versions as the canonical set.
